run.procedureSummary: Each cycle, steps applied to all six crucibles before the next step. (1) Charge: add that cycle's charge to each crucible; overfull is allowed. (2) Overflow: go 1 to 6 in order; any amount over a crucible's working volume moves to the next crucible, which then gets checked in its own turn; anything over crucible 6's volume goes to slag. (3) State check: a BASE crucible at or above its upper mark becomes SUPERHEATED; a SUPERHEATED crucible at or below its lower mark becomes BASE; otherwise no change. Every change is logged as (cycle, position, before, after). (4) Tap: all draws are worked out from the post-check amounts before anything moves. BASE draws floor(q/4) to slag. SUPERHEATED draws floor(q/2) back to the previous crucible, and crucible 1's draw goes to slag. Then all moves are applied together. A crucible left over its volume stays that way until the next cycle's overflow, and stays as is after cycle 5. (5) Emergency tap: if the six crucibles total more than 38 after the tap, each crucible loses floor(q/2) to slag and keeps ceil(q/2), and the cycle is logged. Slag counts every amount that leaves the line (overflow from 6, BASE taps, crucible 1's SUPERHEATED tap, emergency halving).

openPoints.point: Rounding when an emergency tap halves an odd amount
openPoints.assumption: Splits round down, so the amount removed is floor(q/2) and the crucible keeps ceil(q/2). Example: 7 sends 3 to slag and keeps 4.

openPoints.point: When the emergency-tap total is checked
openPoints.assumption: It is checked once per cycle, as the last step after the tap, against the total at that point. It fires only when the total is strictly over 38, so a total of exactly 38 (cycle 3) does not fire.

openPoints.point: Draws for the BASE quarter and the SUPERHEATED half
openPoints.assumption: The draw is floor(q/4) or floor(q/2) of the amount after the state check. All draws are fixed from the same snapshot, then applied together, so melt that arrives on the return launder is not tapped again in the same cycle.

openPoints.point: Crucibles left over volume by the return launder after a tap
openPoints.assumption: They are left as they are. No overflow runs until the next cycle's overflow step, and the emergency tap uses those overfull amounts. In practice no crucible was over volume at the end of cycle 5.

openPoints.point: Which state the tap rule uses
openPoints.assumption: The state just set in that cycle's state check.

openPoints.point: What counts in the slag tally
openPoints.assumption: Every amount that leaves the line: overflow from crucible 6, BASE quarter taps, crucible 1's SUPERHEATED half, and emergency-tap removals.
